answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the trellis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the ledge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the signal of the next round.
